finding.text: The boot proof is not isolated: running `Servex/proof/step-runner-proof.mjs` left 53 modified files in the worktree (`git status` in worktrees/step-runner). The private Servex's heartbeat and TaskLoop wrote fake "revive-queued" and "task-loop escalated: no card" lines into real task.jsonl files (e.g. `ai/2026-10-12/data-grid/grid-core/task.jsonl`). Before merging, revert those files (commit by exact path only), and point the proof at a temp copy of the store (`LEDGER_ROOT` / a `--root`) so it can't write into the repo.

Order step 4 hasn't been done: nothing shows the step runner proven on two real tasks, and there is no before/after followed-rate. plan.md only has the "before" (116 tasks, 0 with an estimate), and STATE.md still shows it ⬜.

`Servex/TaskLoop.js:369`: `nudge_step` writes its log line before the quiet check reads the file's mtime, so a nudge resets the 10-minute quiet chase for that task. This may be fine, but it should be a decision, not an accident.
The nudge only reaches tasks that pass `heartbeat.opted_in` (`TaskLoop.js:65`). So a task with steps but without `heartbeat: true` is never nudged, and the doc should say so.

`Server/Steps.mjs:183`: a task counts as "all reported" once `step >= steps.length`, even if it jumped from step 1 straight to the last step. That makes the followed-rate look better than it is. Also, `landed_steps` (line 188) is computed and never used.

The nudge text (`TaskLoop.js:408`) asks for `{"assign":{"step":N}}` without `"at":"NOW"`. The clock still works, because it falls back to the nudge line's `at`, but the instruction should match the one `Steps.prompt` gives.

Order step 4 is still open: nothing yet shows the Step runner proven on two real tasks, and plan.md has only the "before" rate (116 tasks, 0 estimated); STATE.md:5 is ⬜. It can only happen after merge and a Servex restart, so it is not a merge blocker, but the task must not land without it.

The worktree (worktrees/step-runner) still has 40 uncommitted files, mostly generated `files.jsonl` and `page.jsonl` (e.g. `public/framework/ai/2026-10-12/task-folders/files.jsonl` deleted); none are task.jsonl any more. Merge by exact path and leave these out, or revert them.

`Servex/TaskLoop.js` nudge_step: the nudge line still moves the file's mtime, so the quiet chase resets on the next tick (it is only protected for the current tick). That is probably fine (a nudge is a chase), but the comment at the call site claims more than it does.

`Server/Steps.mjs` NOTES "Shoot the page at its widths" always says 400/1200/1920/3440, while the review system picks widths by change (`Server/doc/review.md`); point the note at the screenshot-system brief's own rule instead of a fixed list.

A nudge only reaches a task with `heartbeat: true` (doc/steps.md says so, good); worth checking that spawn_agent sets it by default, or most real tasks will only get the hook prompt, never the 2× nudge.
